continuity: Jin Taekyung and the Beast Miao King have crossed the Poisonblood Grounds swamp and entered an even denser region of Poison Mist.
The Poisonblood Grounds contains unknown life-forms, the spirits of countless dead, and dangers capable of killing even powerful martial artists.
The Nanman Beast Palace's legendary sacred treasure is the Beast King Stone, whose existence is uncertain but which is said to command every ferocious beast under heaven.
The Beast King Stone supposedly disappeared after the First Palace Lord and the founding Sect Leader of the Five Poisons Sect grievously wounded each other in battle.
Jin considers Dark Heaven's plan to create a rift in Nanman more credible than a confirmed pursuit of the uncertain Beast King Stone.
A Bai warrior was found dead inside the Poisonblood Grounds, wrapped tightly in sticky, thread-like material.
Thousand-Year Spiders have appeared from the trees and surrounded Jin and the Beast Miao King.
The Quest My Good Sir, Do Not Cross That Swamp gives no stated mission or Reward and declares failure to mean death.
plot: Jin Taekyung and the Beast Miao King cross the Poisonblood Grounds swamp under Poison Mist, fighting deadly creatures while relying on Jin's Myriad-Poison Ring and the Beast Miao King's poison-warding pearl. After the swamp, Jin learns that the Nanman Beast Palace's rumored sacred treasure, the Beast King Stone, supposedly commands every ferocious beast, though its existence is uncertain and its disappearance is tied to the founding conflict with the Five Poisons Sect. In the dense Poison Mist, they investigate a human scream, find a dead Bai warrior wrapped in sticky thread, and are surrounded by creatures descending from a gigantic tree: Thousand-Year Spiders.
translation_decisions: Use Beast King Stone for 수왕석.

Retain My Good Sir, Do Not Cross That Swamp for the Quest title.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung and the Beast Miao King have entered the inner Poisonblood Grounds after crossing its poisonous swamp.
Poison Mist fills the inner region and conceals unknown life-forms and hostile presences.
The Beast Miao King carries a poison-warding pearl, while Jin's Myriad-Poison Ring protects him from the Poison Mist.
The Beast King Stone is a legendary Nanman Beast Palace sacred treasure said to command every ferocious beast, though its existence is uncertain.
Dark Heaven is targeting sacred treasures, and Jin suspects its Nanman objective is connected to creating a rift.
A dead Bai warrior was found wrapped in sticky thread inside the Poisonblood Grounds.
Thousand-Year Spiders have surrounded Jin and the Beast Miao King.
The active Quest provides no known mission or Reward and imposes death upon failure.
open_questions: Why was a Bai warrior inside the Poisonblood Grounds, and what killed him?
What are the Thousand-Year Spiders, and how dangerous is the surrounding swarm?
What lies deeper inside the Poisonblood Grounds?
Is Dark Heaven's Nanman objective connected to the Beast King Stone or another sacred treasure?

Use Mr. Yayul for 야율 씨 in colloquial dialogue.
Retain My Good Sir, Do Not Cross That Swamp for the chain Quest title.
